606	    def reduce_order(self, order_id, lines):
607	        # Reduce a placed order while keeping the deal: surviving rows keep
608	        # their original relative order and per-row deal unit prices; for each
609	        # sku the reduction is taken from the LAST row backwards, zero rows are
610	        # removed and surviving duplicate rows are never merged. Subtotals are
611	        # recomputed at the preserved prices. Paused sales, catalog-less
612	        # products and insufficient stock never block a reduction; whole-order
613	        # cancellation still goes through cancel. The order's own reservation
614	        # for an involved managed product becomes min(old reservation, merged
615	        # remaining quantity) -- only the difference is released, total
616	        # reserved drops and availability rises by the same amount, on_hand,
617	        # other orders and uninvolved products never change. Missing inventory
618	        # or reservation records read as no reservation (never auto-managed or
619	        # topped up); a reservation driven to zero loses its attribution key.
620	        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
621	        if not isinstance(lines, list) or not lines:
622	            raise ValueError("lines must be a nonempty list")
623	        requested = {}
624	        for line in lines:
625	            if not isinstance(line, dict):
626	                raise ValueError("each line must be an object with sku and quantity")
627	            sku = text(line.get("sku"), "sku")
628	            quantity = positive(line.get("quantity"), "quantity")
629	            requested[sku] = requested.get(sku, 0) + quantity
630	        data = self._read()
631	        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
632	        if order is None:
633	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
634	        if order["status"] != "placed":
635	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can be reduced")
636	        current = {}
637	        for line in order["lines"]:
638	            current[line["sku"]] = current.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
639	        remaining_total = {}
640	        for sku, quantity in requested.items():
641	            if sku not in current:
642	                raise ValueError("sku not in order: " + sku)
643	            if quantity > current[sku]:
644	                raise ValueError("reduced quantity exceeds ordered quantity: " + sku)
645	            remaining_total[sku] = current[sku] - quantity
646	        # Reducing every line away is a cancellation and is rejected here.
647	        if sum(current[sku] - requested.get(sku, 0) for sku in current) == 0:
648	            raise ValueError("cannot reduce the whole order; cancel it instead")
649	        # Take each sku's reduction from its last row first by walking the
650	        # rows backwards, then restore the original relative order. Deal unit
651	        # prices travel with their rows and subtotals are recomputed at them;
652	        # zero-quantity rows disappear and surviving duplicates stay split.
653	        deduct = dict(requested)
654	        survivors_reversed = []
655	        for line in reversed(order["lines"]):
656	            sku = line["sku"]
657	            removed = min(line["quantity"], deduct.get(sku, 0))
658	            deduct[sku] = deduct.get(sku, 0) - removed
659	            quantity = line["quantity"] - removed
660	            if quantity:
661	                unit_price = line["unit_price_cents"]
662	                survivors_reversed.append({
663	                    "sku": sku,
664	                    "quantity": quantity,
665	                    "unit_price_cents": unit_price,
666	                    "subtotal_cents": quantity * unit_price,
667	                })
668	        items = list(reversed(survivors_reversed))
669	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
670	        own = data.get("reservations", {}).get(order_id, {})
671	        # Plan every reservation change before mutating inventory, so a
672	        # rejection leaves stock, reservations and history untouched. Only
673	        # managed products hold reservations; a missing inventory record reads
674	        # as no reservation even if a stray attribution key exists.
675	        plan = []
676	        for sku in requested:
677	            entry = inventory.get(sku)
678	            if entry is None:
679	                continue
680	            old = own.get(sku, 0)
681	            new = min(old, remaining_total[sku])
682	            if new != old:
683	                plan.append((sku, old, new))
684	        before_views = {sku: self._stock_view(sku, inventory[sku]) for sku, _, _ in plan}
685	        record = data.get("reservations", {}).get(order_id)
686	        for sku, old, new in sorted(plan):
687	            inventory[sku]["reserved"] -= old - new
688	            if new:
689	                record[sku] = new
690	            else:
691	                record.pop(sku, None)
692	            self._record_stock_event(
693	                data, sku, "reduce-order", order_id,
694	                before_views[sku], self._stock_view(sku, inventory[sku]),
695	            )
696	        if record is not None and not record:
697	            # The order held no other reservations: drop its attribution.
698	            data.get("reservations", {}).pop(order_id, None)
699	        order["lines"] = items
700	        order["total_cents"] = sum(x["subtotal_cents"] for x in items)
701	        self._record_event(data, order_id, "reduce-order", order, False)
702	        self._write(data)
703	        return order

705	    def reserve_order(self, order_id):
706	        # Top up reservations for a placed order whose products became managed
707	        # after it was placed. Deal lines, prices, amounts and status are never
708	        # touched, and paused sales never block the top-up.
709	        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
710	        data = self._read()
711	        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
712	        if order is None:
713	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
714	        if order["status"] != "placed":
715	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can be reserved")
716	        needed = {}
717	        for line in order["lines"]:
718	            needed[line["sku"]] = needed.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
719	        products = data.get("products", {})
720	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
721	        own = data.get("reservations", {}).get(order_id, {})
722	        # Validate every sku and compute every addition against the current
723	        # availability before touching any inventory entry, so a rejected
724	        # top-up leaves stock, reservations and history untouched. A missing
725	        # reservation record reads as zero.
726	        additions = {}
727	        for sku in sorted(needed):
728	            if sku not in products:
729	                raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
730	            entry = inventory.get(sku)
731	            if entry is None:
732	                # Unmanaged products stay unlimited and are never auto-managed.
733	                continue
734	            added = max(0, needed[sku] - own.get(sku, 0))
735	            if added > entry["on_hand"] - entry["reserved"]:
736	                raise ValueError("insufficient stock: " + sku)
737	            if added:
738	                additions[sku] = added
739	        lines = []
740	        for sku in sorted(needed):
741	            if inventory.get(sku) is None:
742	                lines.append({"sku": sku, "quantity": needed[sku], "added": 0, "reserved": 0})
743	            else:
744	                added = additions.get(sku, 0)
745	                lines.append({
746	                    "sku": sku,
747	                    "quantity": needed[sku],
748	                    "added": added,
749	                    "reserved": own.get(sku, 0) + added,
750	                })
751	        result = {"order_id": order_id, "lines": lines}
752	        if not additions:
753	            # Nothing to add: the result is still returned, but no file is
754	            # written and no events are appended.
755	            return result
756	        for sku in sorted(additions):
757	            entry = inventory[sku]
758	            before = self._stock_view(sku, entry)
759	            entry["reserved"] += additions[sku]
760	            self._record_stock_event(data, sku, "reserve-order", order_id, before, self._stock_view(sku, entry))
761	        reservations = data.setdefault("reservations", {}).setdefault(order_id, {})
762	        for sku, added in additions.items():
763	            reservations[sku] = reservations.get(sku, 0) + added
764	        self._record_event(data, order_id, "reserve-order", result, False)
765	        self._write(data)
766	        return result

768	    def reserve_batch(self, order_ids):
769	        # Priority batch top-up: orders are processed in the given order
770	        # (input order is the priority); each order either gets its full new
771	        # demand or is skipped whole and consumes nothing, and later orders
772	        # keep being processed. The whole request is validated before any
773	        # mutation, so a rejected batch leaves data, history and sequences
774	        # untouched and never creates the data directory.
775	        if not isinstance(order_ids, list) or not order_ids:
776	            raise ValueError("order_ids must be a nonempty list")
777	        selected = []
778	        seen = set()
779	        for order_id in order_ids:
780	            order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
781	            if order_id in seen:
782	                raise ValueError("duplicate order_id: " + order_id)
783	            seen.add(order_id)
784	            selected.append(order_id)
785	        data = self._read()
786	        orders = data.get("orders", {})
787	        products = data.get("products", {})
788	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
789	        all_reservations = data.get("reservations", {})
790	        # Merge duplicate sku lines inside each order first; the whole request
791	        # is rejected if any selected order is missing, no longer placed, or
792	        # carries a product outside the current catalog.
793	        demanded = {}  # order_id -> {sku: merged quantity}
794	        for order_id in selected:
795	            order = orders.get(order_id)
796	            if order is None:
797	                raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
798	            if order["status"] != "placed":
799	                raise ValueError("only a placed order can be reserved: " + order_id)
800	            per_order = {}
801	            for line in order["lines"]:
802	                per_order[line["sku"]] = per_order.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
803	            for sku in per_order:
804	                if sku not in products:
805	                    raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
806	            demanded[order_id] = per_order
807	        # Plan against the shared margin (available after every existing
808	        # reservation, including orders outside the batch) without touching
809	        # data: a fitting order consumes margin, a skipped one consumes
810	        # nothing. Existing reservations are never released or transferred.
811	        remaining = {sku: entry["on_hand"] - entry["reserved"] for sku, entry in inventory.items()}
812	        plans = []  # (order_id, fits, needs, additions, available at turn)
813	        for order_id in selected:
814	            per_order = demanded[order_id]
815	            own = all_reservations.get(order_id, {})
816	            needs = {sku: max(0, qty - own.get(sku, 0)) for sku, qty in per_order.items()}
817	            at_turn = {sku: remaining.get(sku, 0) for sku in per_order if sku in inventory}
818	            fits = all(needs[sku] <= at_turn[sku] for sku in at_turn)
819	            additions = {}
820	            if fits:
821	                for sku, need in needs.items():
822	                    if sku in inventory and need:
823	                        additions[sku] = need
824	                        remaining[sku] -= need
825	            plans.append((order_id, fits, needs, additions, at_turn))
826	        results = []
827	        for order_id, fits, needs, additions, at_turn in plans:
828	            per_order = demanded[order_id]
829	            own = all_reservations.get(order_id, {})

881	        target_id = text(target_id, "target_id")

883	            raise ValueError("lines must be a nonempty list")

885	        for line in lines:
886	            if not isinstance(line, dict):
887	                raise ValueError("each line must be an object with sku and quantity")

889	            quantity = positive(line.get("quantity"), "quantity")

891	        data = self._read()
892	        orders = data.get("orders", {})
893	        source = orders.get(source_id)
894	        if source is None:
895	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + source_id)
896	        target = orders.get(target_id)
897	        if target is None:
898	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + target_id)
899	        if source["status"] != "placed":
900	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can transfer a reservation: " + source_id)
901	        if target["status"] != "placed":
902	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can receive a reservation: " + target_id)
903	        if source_id == target_id:
904	            raise ValueError("source and target must be different orders")

914	        source_held = all_reservations.get(source_id, {})

917	        # and both current balances before touching any record, so a rejected
918	        # transfer leaves reservations and history untouched.

920	            if sku not in products:

935	        target_record = records.setdefault(target_id, {})
936	        result_lines = []
937	        for sku in sorted(requested):

939	            source_after = source_record.get(sku, 0) - quantity
940	            target_after = target_record.get(sku, 0) + quantity
941	            if source_after:
942	                source_record[sku] = source_after
943	            else:
944	                source_record.pop(sku, None)
945	            target_record[sku] = target_after
946	            result_lines.append({
947	                "sku": sku,
948	                "quantity": quantity,
949	                "source_reserved": source_after,
950	                "target_reserved": target_after,
951	            })

1039	        # preserved, never repriced against the catalog) and totals the two
1040	        # original amounts. Repricing, paused sales or a missing catalog entry
1041	        # never block a merge, and zero-price lines are kept. Per sku the

1044	        # every other order's reservations never change, shortfalls are never
1045	        # topped up, unmanaged products are never auto-managed and read as
1046	        # zero reservation, and missing inventory/reservation collections or a
1047	        # missing own attribution read as empty. Everything is validated
1048	        # before any mutation, so a rejected merge leaves the file, sequences
1049	        # and every record untouched and never creates the data directory.
1050	        source_id = text(source_id, "source_id")
1051	        target_id = text(target_id, "target_id")
1052	        data = self._read()
1053	        orders = data.get("orders", {})
1054	        source = orders.get(source_id)
1055	        if source is None:
1056	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + source_id)
1057	        target = orders.get(target_id)
1058	        if target is None:
1059	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + target_id)
1060	        if source["status"] != "placed":
1061	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can be merged away: " + source_id)
1062	        if target["status"] != "placed":
1063	            raise ValueError("only a placed order can receive a merge: " + target_id)
1064	        if source_id == target_id:
1065	            raise ValueError("source and target must be different orders")

1067	        # (booleans rejected), and one sku's rows must agree on a single deal
1068	        # price across the merged lines -- the catalog price is never
1069	        # consulted and no row is picked as a substitute.
1070	        merged_prices = {}
1071	        for order in (source, target):
1072	            for line in order["lines"]:
1073	                sku = line["sku"]
1074	                unit_price = line.get("unit_price_cents")
1075	                if type(unit_price) is not int or unit_price < 0:

1094	            for sku, quantity in moved.items():

2336	    def order_relations(self, order_id):
2337	        # Read-only split/merge tracing: starting from one order, follow the
2338	        # split-order and merge-orders events recorded in every current
2339	        # order's history in both directions and return the whole connected
2340	        # group. Relations come only from those events' source/target
2341	        # snapshots (direction is always source -> target); other events
2342	        # create none. Legacy orders without history get nothing fabricated,
2343	        # a one-sided event still links both ends, and later state changes
2344	        # never remove a recorded relation. It never writes, never creates
2345	        # the data directory and never consumes a sequence, so reopening the
2346	        # root gives the same result.
2347	        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
2348	        data = self._read()
2349	        orders = data.get("orders", {})
2350	        if order_id not in orders:
2351	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
2352	        history = data.get("history", {})
2353	        # Scan every current order's history first: one malformed split/merge
2354	        # event anywhere rejects the whole query instead of surfacing partial
2355	        # results. Snapshot ids are normalized with the query id rules
2356	        # (trimmed, case-sensitive).
2357	        linked = {}  # (action, source_id, target_id) -> {(owner_id, sequence)}
2358	        for owner_id in sorted(orders):
2359	            document = history.get(owner_id)
2360	            if document is None:
2361	                continue
2362	            for event in document.get("events", []):
2363	                if not isinstance(event, dict):
2364	                    continue
2365	                action = event.get("action")
2366	                if action not in ("split-order", "merge-orders"):
2367	                    continue
2368	                result = event.get("result")
2369	                if not isinstance(result, dict):
2370	                    raise ValueError("split/merge event result must be an object: " + owner_id)
2371	                source = result.get("source")
2372	                target = result.get("target")
2373	                if not isinstance(source, dict) or not isinstance(target, dict):
2374	                    raise ValueError(
2375	                        "split/merge event result must hold source and target objects: " + owner_id
2376	                    )
2377	                source_id = text(source.get("order_id"), "source order_id")
2378	                target_id = text(target.get("order_id"), "target order_id")
2379	                if source_id == target_id:
2380	                    raise ValueError(
2381	                        "split/merge event source and target must be different orders: " + owner_id
2382	                    )
2383	                if owner_id not in (source_id, target_id):
2384	                    raise ValueError(
2385	                        "split/merge event does not belong to this order's history: " + owner_id
2386	                    )
2387	                for end_id in (source_id, target_id):
2388	                    if end_id not in orders:
2389	                        raise ValueError(
2390	                            "split/merge event references an unknown order: " + end_id
2391	                        )
2392	                key = (action, source_id, target_id)
2393	                linked.setdefault(key, set()).add((owner_id, event.get("sequence")))
2394	        # Walk the group in both directions; cycles cannot duplicate orders
2395	        # or loop forever because every member is visited once.
2396	        adjacency = {}
2397	        for _, source_id, target_id in linked:
2398	            adjacency.setdefault(source_id, set()).add(target_id)
2399	            adjacency.setdefault(target_id, set()).add(source_id)
2400	        component = {order_id}
2401	        stack = [order_id]
2402	        while stack:
2403	            current = stack.pop()
2404	            for neighbor in adjacency.get(current, ()):
2405	                if neighbor not in component:
2406	                    component.add(neighbor)
2407	                    stack.append(neighbor)
2408	        group = []
2409	        all_complete = True
2410	        for member_id in sorted(component):
2411	            document = history.get(member_id)
2412	            complete = False if document is None else document["complete"]
2413	            all_complete = all_complete and complete
2414	            group.append({"order": copy.deepcopy(orders[member_id]), "complete": complete})
2415	        relations = []
2416	        for action, source_id, target_id in sorted(linked, key=lambda key: (key[1], key[2], key[0])):
2417	            if source_id not in component:
2418	                continue
2419	            evidence = sorted(
2420	                ({"order_id": owner, "sequence": sequence}
2421	                 for owner, sequence in linked[(action, source_id, target_id)]),
2422	                key=lambda item: (item["order_id"], item["sequence"]),
2423	            )
2424	            relations.append({
2425	                "action": action,
2426	                "source_id": source_id,
2427	                "target_id": target_id,
2428	                "evidence": evidence,
2429	            })
2430	        return {
2431	            "order_id": order_id,
2432	            "orders": group,
2433	            "relations": relations,
2434	            "complete": all_complete,
2435	        }

2437	    def order_progress(self, order_id):
2438	        # Read-only single-order fulfillment overview: the full order and
2439	        # history results (identical to get/history) plus per-sku fulfillment
2440	        # quantities. It never writes, never fabricates reservations, returns or
2441	        # receipts from history, and missing legacy collections read as empty.
2442	        order_id = text(order_id, "order_id")
2443	        data = self._read()
2444	        order = data.get("orders", {}).get(order_id)
2445	        if order is None:
2446	            raise ValueError("unknown order: " + order_id)
2447	        status = order["status"]
2448	        shipped = status in ("shipped", "delivered")
2449	        ordered = {}
2450	        for line in order["lines"]:
2451	            ordered[line["sku"]] = ordered.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
2452	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
2453	        own = data.get("reservations", {}).get(order_id, {})
2454	        # Active registrations only: cancelled records live in a separate
2455	        # bucket and never count. An active record counts as received when it
2456	        # holds a receipt, otherwise pending; an amended registration's current
2457	        # lines already are its latest list.
2458	        pending = {}
2459	        received = {}
2460	        if shipped:
2461	            receipts = data.get("return_receipts", {})
2462	            for record in data.get("returns", {}).get(order_id, ()):
2463	                bucket = received if record["return_id"] in receipts else pending
2464	                for line in record["lines"]:
2465	                    bucket[line["sku"]] = bucket.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
2466	        lines = []
2467	        for sku in sorted(ordered):
2468	            quantity = ordered[sku]
2469	            # Managed-ness follows the inventory records: stray reservations
2470	            # for an unmanaged sku read as zero. Only placed orders still hold
2471	            # reservations; other statuses read both reservation fields zero.
2472	            if status == "placed" and sku in inventory:
2473	                reserved = own.get(sku, 0)
2474	                needed = max(0, quantity - reserved)
2475	            else:
2476	                reserved = 0
2477	                needed = 0
2478	            shipped_qty = quantity if shipped else 0
2479	            pending_qty = pending.get(sku, 0)
2480	            received_qty = received.get(sku, 0)
2481	            remaining = quantity - pending_qty - received_qty if shipped else 0
2482	            lines.append({
2483	                "sku": sku,
2484	                "ordered": quantity,
2485	                "reserved": reserved,
2486	                "needed": needed,
2487	                "shipped": shipped_qty,
2488	                "pending": pending_qty,
2489	                "received": received_qty,
2490	                "remaining": remaining,
2491	                "net": shipped_qty - received_qty,
2492	            })
2493	        return {"order": self.get(order_id), "history": self.history(order_id), "lines": lines}

2545	    def fulfillment_summary(self):
2546	        # Read-only root-wide fulfillment money summary: only orders whose
2547	        # current status is shipped or delivered count; carts and every other
2548	        # order never do. Shipped quantities equal ordered quantities (never
2549	        # stock deductions); active returns count at their latest lines, split
2550	        # into received (with a receipt) and pending (without), cancelled
2551	        # registrations excluded. Amounts use each order's stored deal price
2552	        # per line, never the current catalog price. Any included order whose
2553	        # line misses a deal price, carries a negative/non-integer/boolean
2554	        # price or inconsistent prices for one sku rejects the whole query. It
2555	        # never writes, never creates the directory and never consumes a
2556	        # sequence; missing legacy collections read as empty.
2557	        data = self._read()
2558	        orders = data.get("orders", {})
2559	        receipts = data.get("return_receipts", {})
2560	        selected = [order for order in orders.values()
2561	                    if order.get("status") in ("shipped", "delivered")]
2562	        totals = {}
2563	        order_count = 0
2564	        for order in selected:
2565	            order_id = order["order_id"]
2566	            order_count += 1
2567	            ordered = {}
2568	            deal_prices = {}
2569	            for line in order["lines"]:
2570	                sku = line["sku"]
2571	                ordered[sku] = ordered.get(sku, 0) + line["quantity"]
2572	                deal_prices.setdefault(sku, []).append(line.get("unit_price_cents"))
2573	            # Validate every deal price of every included order before any
2574	            # money is computed, so one bad legacy line rejects the whole
2575	            # summary instead of surfacing partial totals.
2576	            prices = {}
2577	            for sku, sku_prices in deal_prices.items():
2578	                unit_price = sku_prices[0]
2579	                if type(unit_price) is not int or unit_price < 0:
2580	                    raise ValueError("stored unit price is missing or invalid: " + sku)
2581	                if any(price != unit_price for price in sku_prices):
2582	                    raise ValueError("inconsistent unit prices in order: " + sku)
2583	                prices[sku] = unit_price
2584	            pending = {}
2585	            received = {}
2586	            for record in data.get("returns", {}).get(order_id, ()):
2587	                bucket = received if record["return_id"] in receipts else pending
2588	                for line in record["lines"]:
2589	                    bucket[line["sku"]] = bucket.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
2590	            for sku, quantity in ordered.items():
2591	                pending_qty = pending.get(sku, 0)
2592	                received_qty = received.get(sku, 0)
2593	                net_qty = quantity - received_qty
2594	                unit_price = prices[sku]
2595	                row = totals.setdefault(sku, {
2596	                    "shipped": 0, "pending": 0, "received": 0, "net": 0,
2597	                    "shipped_cents": 0, "pending_cents": 0,
2598	                    "received_cents": 0, "net_cents": 0,
2599	                })
2600	                row["shipped"] += quantity
2601	                row["pending"] += pending_qty
2602	                row["received"] += received_qty
2603	                row["net"] += net_qty
2604	                # Each order's quantities are priced at that order's stored
2605	                # deal price, so the same sku may add different cents across
2606	                # orders; the cross-order sum stays an integer.
2607	                row["shipped_cents"] += quantity * unit_price
2608	                row["pending_cents"] += pending_qty * unit_price
2609	                row["received_cents"] += received_qty * unit_price
2610	                row["net_cents"] += net_qty * unit_price
2611	        lines = []
2612	        summary_totals = {
2613	            "shipped": 0, "pending": 0, "received": 0, "net": 0,
2614	            "shipped_cents": 0, "pending_cents": 0,
2615	            "received_cents": 0, "net_cents": 0,
2616	        }
2617	        for sku in sorted(totals):
2618	            row = totals[sku]
2619	            lines.append({"sku": sku, **row})
2620	            for field in summary_totals:
2621	                summary_totals[field] += row[field]
2622	        return {"order_count": order_count, "lines": lines, "totals": summary_totals}

2624	    def replenishment_report(self):
2625	        # Read-only root-wide replenishment list: per managed sku it merges the
2626	        # reservation demand placed orders still lack with the pending returns
2627	        # that could be received back into stock. Carts, non-placed orders and
2628	        # unmanaged products never contribute demand; received or cancelled
2629	        # returns never contribute projected restock. It never writes, never
2630	        # creates the directory, never consumes a sequence, and never performs
2631	        # a restock, reservation or receive -- the two shortfalls are advisory.
2632	        data = self._read()
2633	        orders = data.get("orders", {})
2634	        products = data.get("products", {})
2635	        inventory = data.get("inventory", {})
2636	        all_reservations = data.get("reservations", {})
2637	        # Duplicate skus in an order merge first; actual reservations come from
2638	        # the current attribution records (missing records read zero). Only
2639	        # managed skus and orders still short of reservation are kept.
2640	        demand = {}  # sku -> reservation-audit-style order rows
2641	        for order_id in sorted(orders):
2642	            order = orders[order_id]
2643	            if order["status"] != "placed":
2644	                continue
2645	            merged = {}
2646	            for line in order["lines"]:
2647	                merged[line["sku"]] = merged.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
2648	            own = all_reservations.get(order_id, {})
2649	            for sku, quantity in merged.items():
2650	                if sku not in inventory:
2651	                    continue
2652	                reserved = own.get(sku, 0)
2653	                unreserved = max(0, quantity - reserved)
2654	                if unreserved <= 0:
2655	                    continue
2656	                demand.setdefault(sku, []).append({
2657	                    "order_id": order_id,
2658	                    "quantity": quantity,
2659	                    "reserved": reserved,
2660	                    "unreserved": unreserved,
2661	                })
2662	        # A listed product is managed by definition, so a legacy inventory
2663	        # record without a catalog entry rejects the whole query.
2664	        for sku in sorted(demand):
2665	            if sku not in products:
2666	                raise ValueError("unknown product: " + sku)
2667	        included = set(demand)
2668	        # Pending returns reuse the return-worklist pending entry shape. A
2669	        # registration is attached to every included sku its latest lines
2670	        # touch; blocked registrations stay visible but contribute no pending
2671	        # quantity for any sku (the whole registration is excluded).
2672	        entries_by_sku = {sku: [] for sku in included}
2673	        pending_qty = {sku: 0 for sku in included}
2674	        receipts = data.get("return_receipts", {})
2675	        for records in data.get("returns", {}).values():
2676	            for record in records:
2677	                if record["return_id"] in receipts:
2678	                    continue
2679	                quantities = {}
2680	                for line in record["lines"]:
2681	                    quantities[line["sku"]] = quantities.get(line["sku"], 0) + line["quantity"]
2682	                touched = sorted(sku for sku in quantities if sku in included)
2683	                if not touched:
2684	                    continue
2685	                order = orders.get(record["order_id"])
2686	                if order is None or order["status"] not in ("shipped", "delivered"):
2687	                    if order is None:
2688	                        raise ValueError("unknown order: " + record["order_id"])
2689	                    raise ValueError(
2690	                        "only a shipped or delivered order can back a return: " + record["order_id"]
2691	                    )
2692	                blockers = []
2693	                for sku in sorted(quantities):
2694	                    if sku not in products:
2695	                        blockers.append({"sku": sku, "reason": "unknown-product"})
2696	                    elif sku not in inventory:
2697	                        blockers.append({"sku": sku, "reason": "unmanaged"})
2698	                entry = {
2699	                    "order_id": record["order_id"],
2700	                    "return_id": record["return_id"],
2701	                    "stage": "pending",
2702	                    "lines": [{"sku": sku, "quantity": quantities[sku]} for sku in sorted(quantities)],
2703	                    "can_receive": not blockers,
2704	                    "blockers": blockers,
2705	                }
2706	                for sku in touched:
2707	                    entries_by_sku[sku].append(entry)
2708	                    if entry["can_receive"]:
2709	                        pending_qty[sku] += quantities[sku]

2711	        for sku in sorted(included):
2712	            rows = sorted(demand[sku], key=lambda row: row["order_id"])
2713	            needed = sum(row["unreserved"] for row in rows)
2714	            returns = sorted(entries_by_sku[sku], key=lambda entry: entry["return_id"])
2715	            # Reuse the stock query itself so the embedded view is always
2716	            # identical to a standalone stock call.
2717	            stock = self.stock(sku)
2718	            available = stock["available"]
2719	            pending = pending_qty[sku]
2720	            report.append({
2721	                "sku": sku,
2722	                "stock": stock,
2723	                "needed": needed,
2724	                "pending": pending,
2725	                "shortfall": max(0, needed - available),
2726	                "projected_shortfall": max(0, needed - available - pending),
2727	                "orders": rows,
2728	                "returns": returns,
2729	            })

2732	    def order_worklist(self, stage="open"):

2736	        # writes, never creates the data directory, never consumes a sequence,
2737	        # and never fabricates reservations, returns or receipts from history;

2743	            raise ValueError("stage must be one of: open, all, reserve, ship, deliver, receive-return")
2744	        data = self._read()
2745	        orders = data.get("orders", {})

2748	            progress = self.order_progress(order_id)
2749	            status = progress["order"]["status"]
2750	            lines = progress["lines"]
2751	            tasks = []
2752	            if status == "placed":
